name: kernellib
description: Write kernel methods in JAX on kernellib — kernels as Equinox modules, Gram matrices as gaussx operators, matrix-free and preconditioned solves, random-feature and Nyström approximations, kernel ridge regression at scale, HSIC / CKA / MMD tests, graph kernels and eigenmaps — instead of hand-rolling distance matrices, Cholesky solves and random features.
